headline: CHC @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.10 at ATL 3.73, with a projected total of 7.82. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved -0.64 runs while ATL moved -0.89, changing the projected margin by +0.26 runs. The projected total fell -1.53, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shota Imanaga has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Matt Olson, Drake Baldwin, Austin Riley, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Moisés Ballesteros, Ian Happ because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
